direction.title: Ground plane: full-bleed built work
direction.summary: The lead project opens as a full-bleed site photograph under a serif title; the other projects sit small and off the grid. Use for spatial practices.

layout.skeleton: full-bleed lead project; title split across two lines; secondary projects offset at 1/3 width; contact in a quiet footer
layout.focus: lead project title at 120px, with its scale and completion year from the brief
layout.desktop: Title bottom-left on an opaque paper panel overlapping the image edge. Facts align in a right-hand column.
layout.mobile: image at 70vh; title below it, not overlaid
layout.rhythm: 160px section gaps; empty space as the material

imagery.subject: the built site at ground or eye level, with planting or material in the foreground
imagery.fallback: site-plan line drawing in ink on paper

motion.effect: the image scales 1.04 to 1 (the one signature move)

action.instruction: Primary link opens the lead case study; contact is plain text
action.label: Open the [project] case study

direction.why: Spacious and material: built work needs room. A serif display paired with a quiet sans and a full-bleed ground reads as real work, not a template.

sources.observation: Studio Dado (viewed): the serif display 'FORM FOLLOWS FEELING' is set full-bleed over warm material photography, with a small sans nav on an offset grid.
Studio D live HTML: 'Spatial design at eye level', positioning spatial practice in plain words.

interaction.focus: Use a two-tone focus ring (2 px paper with 2 px ink outside) on the primary control.
interaction.accent_role: Use the accent as a focal fill under accent_foreground. Check contrast before using it as text.
interaction.keyboard: Expose the primary control by keyboard and announce pending and completed states.

assumptions: Use only the project facts and assets in the brief.
handoff: Apply the composition to the actual content. Preserve the task and brand constraints. Fill label slots only with facts supplied by the brief. Use the source as design evidence. Verify the action, reading order and legibility at 390 px.
